# ipzilon_network_zones (Data Source)

List network zones by name and/or CIDR without knowing any id (IPzilon >= 3.1.0). A zone name is only unique within its network, so a name filter may return several zones; add network_id to narrow it. Without filters every zone is returned. Provide id alone to look up a single zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires IPzilon >= 3.1.0.

# Look a zone up by its CIDR only, without any id
data "ipzilon_network_zones" "pooled" {
  cidr = "10.0.16.0/23"
}

# A zone name is only unique within its network: add network_id to narrow it
data "ipzilon_network_zones" "personal" {
  network_id = ipzilon_network.example.id
  name       = "personal_zone"
}

output "pooled_zone_id" {
  value = data.ipzilon_network_zones.pooled.items[0].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cidr` (String) Filter: exact cidr match (server-side).
- `id` (Number) Lookup a single zone by ID. Cannot be combined with other filters.
- `name` (String) Filter: exact name match (server-side).
- `network_id` (Number) Filter: zones of this network (server-side).

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) Matching zones, ordered by CIDR. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String) Zone CIDR block.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `id` (Number) Zone ID.
- `name` (String) Zone name (unique within its network).
- `network_id` (Number) Network the zone belongs to.
